question.text: What are the trading hours for cross-currency futures (EUR-USD, GBP-USD, USD-JPY)?

answer.text: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 7:30 PM
Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM
Monday to Friday, 9:15 AM to 3:30 PM

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook (p.57), cross-currency futures trade Monday to Friday from 9:00 a.m. to 7:30 p.m. Page 56 confirms that INR-based futures trade from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., which gives the contrast: cross-currency futures stay open about 2.5 hours longer than INR-pair futures. The Trap: INR-based currency futures close at 5:00 p.m., not 7:30 p.m.; the longer session belongs to the cross-currency pairs. Note: The 9:00 a.m. - 7:30 p.m. window applies on regular trading days, Monday to Friday.
